items.subject: rows of plain headstones of former Wittenoom miners and residents in a Western Australian cemetery, 1989
items.action: dry wind stirs faded plastic-free paper wreaths and red dust between the graves
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction runs down the long rows toward a flat ochre horizon
items.setting: late-1980s outback-edge cemetery, red earth plots, low iron railings, sparse saltbush
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, sun-bleached grey stone, pale dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a single sun-faded enamel photo plaque on a weathered headstone
items.lighting: soft late-afternoon daylight, long gentle shadows
items.mood: still air, long shadows, rows receding into heat haze
items.narration_anchor: En mil novecientos ochenta y nueve ya habían muerto más de quinientos antiguos trabajadores y residentes de Wittenoom.

items.subject: former Wittenoom workers and widows, Anglo-Australian and Spanish and Italian migrants in their 50s and 60s, stocky and thin builds
items.action: gathered on folding chairs at an early meeting of the asbestos victims' society, 1979
items.gaze_interaction: most seen from behind facing a trestle table; a grey-haired Spanish widow in a cardigan turns her shoulders toward a gaunt Anglo-Australian man leaning on a walking stick
items.setting: plain Perth community hall, fibro walls, louvred windows, tea urn on a side table
items.color_palette: faded beige, brown cardigans, olive and grey, warm window light
items.props_detail: a hand-written sign-up ledger on the trestle table
items.camera_angle: slightly high angle from the back of the hall
items.lighting: soft diffuse daylight through louvred windows
items.mood: stooped shoulders, men pausing for breath, quiet hall in pale light
items.narration_anchor: Los que seguían vivos se habían juntado diez años antes en la Asbestos Diseases Society of Australia.

items.subject: an elderly Anglo-Australian judge in his 60s in wig and robe, small at a high timber bench
items.action: reads the 1988 verdict aloud from typed pages
items.gaze_interaction: judge's head bowed to the pages; gallery of former workers seen from behind, some leaning forward, one thin man with an arm across a younger woman's shoulders
items.setting: Perth Supreme Court courtroom, late 1980s, dark jarrah panelling, high windows
items.color_palette: dark jarrah brown, black robes, muted greys, pale window light
items.props_detail: a typed judgment resting on the bench under a brass reading lamp
items.camera_angle: eye-level from the rear of the public gallery
items.lighting: soft daylight from high windows, calm shafts across the panelling
items.mood: motionless gallery, bodies leaning forward, dust motes in the window light
items.narration_anchor: En mil novecientos ochenta y ocho un juez leyó su veredicto: la compañía había mostrado un desprecio continuo, consciente y contumaz por la seguridad y la salud de sus trabajadores.

items.subject: an elderly Spanish-born woman in her mid-60s, slight build, short grey hair, former Wittenoom child resident
items.action: slides on the patient table into the ring of a CT scanner
items.gaze_interaction: lying still, eyes turned up toward the scanner ring, hands resting on her hospital gown
items.setting: quiet Western Australian hospital imaging room, pale walls, white scanner ring
items.color_palette: clinical white, pale blue-grey, soft skin tones
items.props_detail: the large white scanner ring encircling her chest
items.camera_angle: eye-level from the foot of the table
items.mood: body motionless, shoulders flat on the table, hushed pale room
items.narration_anchor: Mercedes de Juan, que se quedó en Australia, entra en un escáner y después sopla en un tubo.

items.subject: the same elderly Spanish-born woman, mid-60s, slight build, grey hair, in a cardigan
items.action: blows hard into the mouthpiece tube of a lung function test
items.gaze_interaction: seated upright, face in profile, cheeks drawn in, eyes fixed ahead toward the window
items.setting: small hospital respiratory clinic, plain desk, window onto a Perth suburb
items.color_palette: soft white, muted teal, warm cardigan brown
items.props_detail: a spirometer tube with a white mouthpiece held to her lips
items.lighting: soft window daylight from the side
items.mood: chest straining, shoulders lifted on the long breath, gentle window light
items.narration_anchor: «Nos hacen un escáner y una prueba de función pulmonar», dice Mercedes.

items.subject: blue asbestos tailings on red earth
items.action: fine fibres lift loose in a faint breeze
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction on the drifting strands catching the light
items.setting: ground near Wittenoom, red desert soil
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, grey-blue fibre glints
items.props_detail: a single strand drifting upward against the light
items.lens_technique: macro lens, shallow depth of field
items.narration_anchor: Las fibras pueden causar mesotelioma, asbestosis y cáncer de pulmón.

items.subject: a government health records archive
items.action: rows of medical case files sit untouched, the last shelf half empty
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction down the aisle toward the unfinished shelf
items.setting: Perth state archive room, steel shelving, linoleum floor
items.color_palette: manila beige, grey steel, faded green
items.props_detail: a closed register book left on a cart at the end of the aisle
items.lighting: soft fluorescent wash and pale window light
items.mood: dust settled on shelves, empty aisle, flat quiet light
items.narration_anchor: La cuenta oficial se detuvo. «El gobierno dejó de contar en 2.000, pero ahora se calcula que la cifra puede ser superior a los 4.000.

items.subject: middle-aged children of Wittenoom police and teachers, Anglo-Australian men and women in their 50s, ordinary builds
items.action: wait in a hospital respiratory clinic corridor for results
items.gaze_interaction: mostly seen from behind on plastic-free wooden benches; a balding man rests elbows on knees, a woman with greying hair looks toward a frosted window
items.setting: Western Australian hospital waiting area, pale walls, frosted glass
items.color_palette: pale cream, muted blue, soft grey
items.props_detail: a large brown X-ray envelope on a man's lap
items.camera_angle: eye-level from the end of the corridor
items.mood: hunched backs, still waiting bodies, gentle grey light
items.narration_anchor: Y sigue aumentando», dice Melita Markey. Están enfermando hijos de policías y de maestros que trabajaron en el pueblo.

items.subject: the deserted town of Wittenoom
items.action: empty streets lie silent, cleared lots where houses have been removed
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction across the town toward the red gorge ranges
items.setting: Pilbara desert, abandoned mining town under progressive demolition
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, rust, faded paint, hints of blue tailings, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a bare concrete slab where a house once stood
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide lens
items.mood: long calm shadows, no movement, vast quiet land
items.narration_anchor: Mientras los enfermos se contaban a sí mismos, el Estado decidió qué hacer con el pueblo: borrarlo.

items.subject: an Anglo-Australian road worker in his 40s, sturdy build, wide-brim hat, sun-faded work shirt
items.action: unbolts the name plate from a roadside town sign, June 2007
items.gaze_interaction: seen from behind on a short ladder, head tilted to the bolts
items.setting: empty Pilbara highway shoulder, red dirt verge, spinifex, distant ranges
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, sun-faded green sign, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: the detached name plate tilting off the signpost
items.mood: lone figure in vast flat land, heat shimmer, dust on boots
items.narration_anchor: Junio de dos mil siete; otras fuentes dicen dos mil seis. Wittenoom es abolido formalmente. Le quitan el nombre a las señales de la carretera y lo sacan de los mapas.

items.subject: Parliament House of Western Australia in Perth
items.action: stands calm and closed as the official statement is released
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction up the steps toward the colonnade
items.setting: Perth, 2007, manicured lawns and sandstone facade
items.color_palette: warm sandstone, green lawn, soft gold sky
items.props_detail: a flag hanging limp on the rooftop pole
items.mood: still flag, empty steps, gentle warm light
items.narration_anchor: El gobierno de Australia Occidental habla de «el fin de un período oscuro en la historia de nuestro Estado».

items.subject: a bound 1992 parliamentary inquiry report
items.action: lies closed and pushed aside on an empty committee table
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction on the report at the table's edge
items.setting: Western Australian parliamentary committee room, green leather chairs, timber table
items.color_palette: dark timber, faded green leather, cream paper
items.props_detail: the report with a paperclipped response note on top
items.lighting: soft window daylight across the table
items.mood: empty chairs, dust in the light, nothing moving
items.narration_anchor: Quince años antes, en mil novecientos noventa y dos, una investigación parlamentaria había recomendado limpiar los relaves. El gobierno rechazó esas recomendaciones.

items.subject: blue asbestos tailings dumps in Wittenoom Gorge
items.action: spill down from the old mine site toward the gorge floor
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction from the tailings down the gorge
items.setting: Wittenoom Gorge, red banded cliffs, dry creek bed
items.color_palette: deep red rock, ochre, grey-blue tailings, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a rusted ore chute jutting from the cliff above the dumps
items.camera_angle: high angle from the gorge rim
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide lens
items.lighting: soft late-afternoon light raking the cliffs
items.mood: silent gorge, long shadows, no living figure
items.narration_anchor: «La minería en los desfiladeros ha dejado una contaminación que solo puede describirse como vergonzosa, incluso para los estándares de la época», dijo Larry Graham.

items.subject: blue asbestos tailings at the edge of a creek
items.action: wind lifts a pale haze of dust off the tailings and carries it over the water
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction following the drifting haze downstream
items.setting: creek and floodplain below Wittenoom Gorge, river gums, red banks
items.color_palette: red earth, olive gum leaves, grey-blue haze, pale water
items.props_detail: a pale film of fibres settled on a still pool
items.mood: slow drifting haze, still water, muted light
items.narration_anchor: «Tenemos el deber de impedir una mayor dispersión de los relaves de asbesto», dijo Mark Nevill, por los residentes, por los visitantes, por las generaciones futuras.

items.subject: a locked steel gate barring a dirt road into the gorge
items.action: stands chained shut while the road beyond fades into the ranges
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction through the gate along the empty road
items.setting: Pilbara access road, red dirt, spinifex, distant gorge mouth
items.color_palette: rust, red earth, ochre, faded warning yellow, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a heavy padlock and chain on the gate
items.mood: empty road, closed gate, long calm shadows

text_in_image.location: on a metal sign wired to the gate

items.narration_anchor: En dos mil dieciséis, los documentos dicen por qué los relaves siguen donde están: no porque no se pueda, sino por lo que cuesta.

items.subject: blue asbestos tailings dust drifting past an abandoned veranda
items.action: wind carries the dust beyond the last barricade and out across the open plain
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction from a rusted chair on the veranda out toward the endless horizon
items.setting: edge of abandoned Wittenoom, decaying fibro house, open Pilbara plain
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, faded paint, grey-blue dust, soft dusk sky
items.props_detail: a rusted chair left on the sagging veranda
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide lens
items.mood: dust trailing into the horizon, empty chair, settling evening calm
items.narration_anchor: En dos mil veintitrés, los estudios del Estado sobre hasta dónde llega la contaminación ya estaban desactualizados. Borraron el nombre del mapa. El polvo no leía mapas.
